title: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child puts u- nouns with a zi- plural (ukuta/kuta) in U-ZI and ma- nouns with no singular (maji, mafuta) in YA-YA, and agrees every word.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ukuta mrefu umeanguka" and "Kuta ndefu zimeanguka".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Ukuta yameanguka." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukuta ni wa U-ZI na hutumia u-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi kwa wingi." Kwa nini "Kuta umeanguka." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Maji zimemwagika." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maji ni ya YA-YA na hutumia ya-.
Wingi wa ukuta ni kuta: U-ZI.
